name: @elizaos/cloud
description: Hosted services a deployment runs for on-device agents: identity, native clients, billing, inference, speech, maps and managed mail and calendar.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && vibelang -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const source=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const target=value=>value.startsWith('./dist/')?'./'+value.slice(7):value;for(const file of fs.globSync('src/**/*.sql')){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname('dist/'+file),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(file,'dist/'+file);}const publishedExports=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(source.exports).map(([name,conditions])=>[name,Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(conditions).map(([condition,value])=>[condition,target(condition==='eliza-source'?(conditions.import??conditions.default):value)]))]));const publication={...source,main:target(source.main),types:target(source.types),bin:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(source.bin).map(([name,value])=>[name,target(value)])),files:['src','gen','pages'],exports:publishedExports};delete publication.scripts;delete publication.publishConfig;fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json',JSON.stringify(publication,null,2)+'\n');"
scripts.start: node --import vibelang/register src/main.vibe serve --profile test/fixtures/profile.json --environment staging --store pglite:.cache/cloud.pglite --seed test/fixtures/seed.json
